summary_en: Furyu Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 2.5 million shares (9.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 3 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 20, 2026 to March 23, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and per-share value while maintaining financial soundness for future growth investments.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Furyu Corporation's Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury shares based on the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation. The company is authorized to purchase up to 2.5 million shares (9.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 3 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 20, 2026 and March 23, 2027.

The company stated that this acquisition is part of its disciplined capital allocation strategy to enhance capital efficiency while maintaining financial soundness. Furyu is pursuing dual objectives: expanding "earnings power" through growth investments and enhancing "capital deployment capability" through efficient capital management. The buyback program supports the company's medium-term vision targeting ROE of 15% or above by the fiscal year ending March 2028.

The company emphasized that it prioritizes necessary growth investments and maintains sufficient liquidity and financial health. Surplus capital that exceeds requirements for future business investments and financial stability will be actively returned to shareholders through this buyback and other shareholder returns. The acquisition aims to improve per-share value and maximize long-term shareholder value while demonstrating the company's commitment to disciplined capital allocation under its capital allocation policy.
